result.summary: The home screen has a broken delivery-fee value (€NaN) on a restaurant card, plus a few minor layout/styling nits.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows “€NaN delivery” instead of a valid fee.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing or invalid delivery-fee data (fallback, hide the fee, or show a loading/error state) so NaN never appears to users.

issues.description: The last category chip is only partially visible at the right edge, which is expected for a carousel, but the chips sit tight against the screen edge with no consistent right padding.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal inset or fade so the row still reads as scrollable without looking cut off.

issues.description: Restaurant card titles and fee text sit very close to the image and neighboring cards, so the grid feels cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase spacing between image, title, and delivery-fee line for clearer hierarchy.
